output.explanation: Expanded io-terminal because Screen and PageList hide substantial owned composition. Its central tree now emphasizes Terminal -> ScreenSet -> Screen -> PageList; two new peripheral diagrams elaborate per-screen state and page storage. Left surface, io, renderer, services and io-exec unchanged, retaining every existing edge and moving endpoints where details moved. Verified the pinned checkout using Terminal.zig, ScreenSet.zig, Screen.zig, PageList.zig, page.zig, Termio.zig, renderer code and search code. No contradictory ownership claims were found in the checked relationships. The expansion clarifies that cursor/selection pins refer into PageList-managed storage, active aliases an owned Screen, compressed nodes retain virtual mappings, and renderer compression scheduling is separate from PageList-owned continuation state.

diagrams.ascii:
Surface: one terminal session (src/Surface.zig)
|
|-- Session flags: id, focused, visible, readonly, child_exited, command_timer
|-- app, rt_app, rt_surface: borrowed application/runtime references
|-- init() -> constructs owned state; starts renderer and IO workers
|-- deinit() -> joins search, renderer, IO; then frees resources and grid ref
|-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit()); host completes destruction
|-- surfaceMailbox(): address adapter, not a separate owned queue
|   `-- -> App.mailbox -> main-thread handleMessage() -> runtime UI actions
|-- config: copied DerivedConfig; config_conditional_state
|   `-- updateConfig() -> replaces settings; messages IO and renderer
|-- font_grid_key, font_size, font_metrics, font_size_adjusted
|   `-- setFontSize() -> SharedGridSet.ref(); sends grid replacement to renderer
|-- size: renderer.Size (screen pixels, cells, padding)
|   `-- scale/size callbacks -> resize() -> IO and renderer resize messages
|-- keyboard: Keyboard; pressed_key; last_binding_trigger
|   |-- Key sequences, queued input, active key-table stack
|   `-- keyCallback() -> bindings/actions, otherwise encodeKey()
|       `-- -> input.key_encode using io.terminal modes -> queueIo()
|-- mouse: Mouse (buttons, modifiers, links, SelectionGesture)
|   `-- Callbacks -> terminal selection/viewport; mouse encoding; runtime URLs
|-- Text, IME and clipboard callbacks
|   `-- -> renderer_state.preedit; runtime clipboard; mode-aware paste encoding
|-- queueIo(): ownership-transferring outgoing message gate
|   `-- -> io.queueMessage(); readonly drops writes, not selection/scroll/copy
|-- io: owned termio.Termio [expanded in IO diagram]
|-- io_thread: owned termio.Thread; io_thr: worker handle
|   |-- Event loop, stop signal, resize coalescing, selection-scroll timers
|   `-- -> drains io.mailbox; backend writes; synchronized-output timeout
|-- renderer_state: owned renderer.State shared-access bridge
|   |-- Surface-allocated mutex, demand/handoff counters, preedit, mouse state
|   |-- terminal pointer -> io.terminal; inspector pointer -> owned inspector
|   `-- lockDemand()/unlockDemand() arbitrate snapshots with busy IO parsing
|-- renderer: owned GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) [expanded in renderer diagram]
|-- renderer_thread: owned renderer.Thread; renderer_thr: worker handle
|   |-- Mailbox, event loop, wakeup/draw signals, blink/animation timers
|   |-- Wakeup -> renderer.updateFrame()/drawFrame(); visibility gates work
|   `-- Compression scheduler -> io.terminal incremental scrollback compression
|-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true), for host-driven synchronous drawing
|-- search: optional owned Surface.Search
|   |-- state: terminal.search.Thread
|   |   |-- Mailbox, refresh timer, TerminalSearch/ScreenSearch, match tracking
|   |   `-- -> io.terminal under shared lock; copies data for searching
|   |-- thread: worker handle; Search.deinit() stops and joins it
|   `-- searchCallback_()
|       |-- -> renderer mailbox: viewport and selected-match highlights
|       `-- -> Surface mailbox: match count and selected index
`-- inspector: optional owned Inspector (src/inspector/Inspector.zig)
    |-- GUI state, mouse inspection, key history and VT recording
    |-- activate/deactivate -> shared pointer; notifies IO and renderer
    `-- recordKeyEvent() <- input events/bytes; recordPtyRead() <- Termio

io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|
|-- backend: owned Backend.exec / Exec [expanded in io-exec]
|   |-- initTerminal() -> initializes sibling terminal's pwd and backend size
|   `-- threadEnter()/threadExit() -> worker-local execution state, not an Exec field
|-- terminal_stream: owned terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
|   |-- Parser state
|   `-- handler: StreamHandler (src/termio/stream_handler.zig)
|       |-- APC/DCS handlers; Kitty clipboard grants and pending write
|       |-- Optional tmux viewer (when compiled in)
|       |-- terminal pointer -> sibling terminal; mutations under shared mutex
|       `-- -> IO replies, Surface messages and renderer wakeups
|-- terminal: owned authoritative terminal.Terminal [expanded in io-terminal]
|-- mailbox: owned IO queue
|   `-- Surface.io_thread drains messages -> backend writes / terminal operations
|-- config: owned DerivedConfig; size: cached renderer.Size
|-- thread_enter_state: optional owned arena and initial input; freed on entry
|-- processOutput(bytes): called by backend reader
|   |-- Acquires borrowed Surface.renderer_state.mutex
|   |-- Normal path -> terminal_stream.nextSlice(bytes)
|   |-- Inspector active -> recordPtyRead() and byte-wise parsing
|   `-- Schedules render; notifies IO mailbox if handler queued replies
|-- resize(): PTY resize + Terminal.resize() under the same mutex
|   `-- -> renderer resize message and wakeup
|-- threadEnter(thread, data): initializes caller-held Termio.ThreadData
|   |-- Stored on Surface.io_thread's worker stack, not inside Termio
|   `-- backend.exec: Exec.ThreadData -> read/write/watch resources [io-exec]
|-- deinit(): releases backend, terminal, config, mailbox and stream state
`-- Borrowed renderer_state, renderer mailbox/wakeup and Surface address

renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) (src/renderer/generic.zig)
|
|-- terminal_state: owned terminal.RenderState snapshot
|-- font_shaper: owned font.Shaper
|-- Per-surface GPU frames, shaders, cells and images
|-- Search match/highlight data received through renderer mailbox
|-- font_grid: borrowed SharedGrid pointer; device: App-scoped dependency
|-- updateFrame(shared renderer.State)
|   |-- lockDemand() -> snapshot io.terminal -> unlockDemand()
|   `-- Snapshot + font grid + selection/search -> renderable cells/images
|-- drawFrame() -> selected Metal or OpenGL graphics implementation
|-- setFontGrid() <- renderer.Thread handles replacement message
|   `-- Thread installs new grid, then SharedGridSet.deref(old_key)
`-- Lifecycle -> releases per-surface resources, not the App-owned device

Outside Surface: application and host services
|
|-- App (src/App.zig): borrowed by Surface
|   |-- surfaces: registry of runtime surfaces, not Surface-owned layout
|   |-- mailbox: application queue for surface-addressed messages
|   |   `-- Dispatch checks active surface -> Surface.handleMessage()
|   |-- font_grid_set: owned font.SharedGridSet
|   |   `-- Ref-counted SharedGrid entries (src/font/SharedGrid.zig)
|   |       |-- Owned resolver/fallback collection and font metrics
|   |       `-- Codepoint/glyph caches and grayscale/color atlases
|   `-- device: owned, lazily initialized renderer.Device
`-- apprt.runtime / host (src/apprt.zig)
    |-- Native UI and window/tab/split lifecycle outside the core Surface
    |-- Input/geometry callbacks -> Surface
    |-- performAction() <- titles, notifications, scrollbar and UI changes
    |-- Clipboard requests/completion and URL-opening services
    `-- rt_surface.close(confirm) -> host-driven Surface destruction

backend: Backend.exec / Exec (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|
|-- subprocess: owned Subprocess
|   |-- Arena, command arguments, environment, cwd and shell-integration setup
|   |-- Cached grid/pixel size; runtime pre-exec/post-fork information
|   |-- pty: optional owned Pty
|   `-- process: optional fork/exec Command or Flatpak host command
|-- initTerminal(terminal) -> set pwd; initialize cached backend dimensions
|-- threadEnter(io, td): starts subprocess and initializes caller-held state
|   `-- -> td.backend.exec: Exec.ThreadData (on IO worker stack)
|       |-- Exit watcher/completions; start time and exited flag
|       |   `-- Child exit -> Surface mailbox
|       |-- write_stream, write_queue and pooled Write requests/buffers
|       |   `-- queueWrite() -> PTY bytes; completion returns pooled requests
|       |-- termios timer/completion and cached mode (polling on POSIX)
|       `-- read_thread handle, PTY read fd and quit-pipe write end
|           `-- -> ReadThread entry (borrows Termio; joined on threadExit)
|               |-- POSIX reader's stack: Pipeline and gather worker handle
|               |   |-- Pipeline: four 64 KiB buffers, ring metadata, conditions
|               |   |   `-- Gather/parse exchange slots; bounded backpressure
|               |   |-- Gather worker -> read/poll PTY, publish batches
|               |   `-- Parse stage -> Termio.processOutput(batch)
|               |       `-- Batch boundary -> renderer_state.yieldToDemand()
|               `-- Windows: serial blocking read -> Termio.processOutput()
|-- resize() -> PTY size; caller Termio also resizes sibling terminal
|-- threadExit(td): stops child, signals reader, joins it (reader joins gather)
|   `-- Caller then deinitializes ThreadData: stream, watcher, pool, timer, pipe
`-- deinit() -> Subprocess.deinit(); no ownership of terminal or renderer

terminal: terminal.Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|
|-- screens: owned ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
|   |-- all: EnumMap owning allocated Screen pointers
|   |   `-- Screen, per initialized entry [expanded in terminal-screen]
|   |       |-- Primary always initialized; alternate lazy, without scrollback
|   |       |-- pages: owned PageList [expanded in terminal-pages]
|   |       `-- Cursor, selection and per-screen protocol state
|   |-- active_key and active: alias one owned Screen, not another instance
|   |-- generations: per-key counters for storage removal/replacement
|   `-- deinit() -> deinitializes and destroys every allocated Screen
|-- modes, colors, tabstops and scrolling_region
|-- Grid/pixel dimensions and terminal-level cursor state
|-- title and pwd: owned buffers
|-- Glyph registrations; optional Kitty drag/drop state; mouse/dirty flags
|-- Editing, scrolling and screen switching operations
|   `-- Mutate owned screens/pages; caller provides synchronization
|-- resize() -> screen resizing and page reflow
|   `-- Termio coordinates PTY resize under the same Surface shared mutex
`-- External access (no transfer of ownership)
    |-- StreamHandler -> terminal operations under Surface shared mutex
    |-- Renderer -> RenderState snapshot under lockDemand()/unlockDemand()
    |-- Search -> reads/copies terminal data under shared lock
    `-- Renderer thread -> Terminal.compress() -> owned PageList compression

Screen: one ScreenSet-owned entry (src/terminal/Screen.zig)
|
|-- pages: owned PageList [expanded in terminal-pages]
|-- cursor: owned Cursor value
|   |-- x/y, cursor style, pending wrap and protection
|   |-- style value and page-local style_id
|   |-- Hyperlink IDs and semantic-content state
|   |-- hyperlink: optional owned heap object, survives cursor page changes
|   `-- page_pin, page_row, page_cell: references into pages
|       `-- page_pin is tracked by PageList; row/cell pointers are cached
|-- saved_cursor: optional value snapshot, not another live page cursor
|-- selection: optional tracked Selection
|   |-- select() tracks incoming bounds and releases superseded pins
|   `-- Bounds refer to PageList-managed pins; changes mark selection dirty
|-- charset and protected_mode: per-screen interpretation state
|-- Kitty protocol state
|   |-- kitty_keyboard: KeyFlagStack
|   `-- kitty_images: owned ImageStorage when graphics are enabled
|-- semantic_prompt: seen flag and OSC 133 click state
|-- dirty: selection and hyperlink-hover flags
|-- no_scrollback: explicit policy; zero page budget alone is insufficient
|-- init()
|   `-- Initializes pages, tracks cursor pin, configures image storage
|-- resize()
|   `-- -> PageList resize/reflow; maintains cursor and selection references
`-- deinit()
    `-- Releases images, cursor hyperlink allocation and PageList storage

PageList: Screen-owned storage (src/terminal/PageList.zig)
|
|-- pool: owned MemoryPool
|   |-- nodes: NodePool
|   |-- pages: PagePool for standard backing allocations
|   `-- pins: PinPool
|-- pages: ordered intrusive list, oldest history through active area
|   `-- Node: prev/next, serial and explicit pool/heap allocation provenance
|       `-- data: resident or compressed representation
|           |-- resident: Page (src/terminal/page.zig)
|           |   |-- memory: contiguous page-aligned backing allocation
|           |   |-- rows and cells: offsets into backing memory
|           |   |-- styles: page-local style set
|           |   |-- grapheme allocator and cell-to-grapheme map
|           |   |-- string allocator; hyperlink map and reference-counted set
|           |   `-- size, capacity and page dirty flag
|           `-- compressed: compression.Page
|               |-- Retained Page metadata and virtual mapping
|               |-- Owned encoding; raw physical memory discarded
|               `-- Node.page() restores mapping contents and frees encoding
|-- tracked_pins: set of pool-allocated pins updated by page mutations
|-- viewport: active/top/pin; preallocated viewport_pin and cached row offset
|-- cols/rows: desired grid dimensions; total_rows for scrollbar accounting
|-- limits and page_size: scrollback policy and logical raw-mapping accounting
|-- page_serial and page_serial_epoch: stale-reference detection
|-- page_compression: owned IncrementalCompressionState
|   |-- Pass/verification flags and activity serial
|   `-- Traversal serials, not a retained node pointer
|-- compress(): bounded incremental work on cold historical pages
|   `-- <- Terminal.compress(); renderer schedules calls under shared lock
`-- deinit() -> releases tracked-pin set, page/node storage and pools

edges.label: Borrowed App; shared services are outside Surface
Authoritative emulator state -> frame snapshot, not ownership
Wake renderer worker to update frame
Borrow shared glyph caches and atlases
Worker-local backend state expanded; not an Exec field
Initialize terminal pwd; read dimensions for backend
Termio coordinates PTY and terminal resize under one mutex
Yield between batches to snapshot demand
Child-exit notification uses Surface-addressed App mailbox
Snapshot reads owned terminal state without taking ownership
Search copies data from authoritative terminal
Renderer schedules compression; PageList owns compression state
Owned backing storage, not a sibling terminal service
Selection bounds use tracked pins updated with page mutations
Terminal delegates compression work to owned page storage
